transforms.description: An assistant message's content keeps only the text after its last </think>, with leading newlines removed; the reasoning before it is re-emitted inside <think> only for turns after the last user query, and dropped from earlier turns.
A past model turn's content drops every <|channel>...<channel|> thinking block (macro strip_thinking) and is then trimmed.
Message content, or each text part of it, is rendered through |trim, so leading and trailing whitespace is removed.
A leading system message is not rendered under its own role: its content, followed by a blank line, is prefixed to the first user turn.

A past assistant turn renders only its content, on the final channel; its thinking (the analysis channel) is dropped. A tool-call turn's analysis is kept only while no later assistant turn without tool calls follows.
